title: Left Out
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: When other girls don't include Sanyu, she learns about responding with grace instead of anger.
keywords: kindness, anger, emotions, friendship, Uganda, girls, virtue, grace
dedication: For every girl learning to be kind even when others are not.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: The village girls are playing without Sanyu. Her heart hurts and she wants to yell. But Mercy's story gives her another way.
